title: 整合企业问卷：2026 年的 13 个模块
summary: 2024 年起气候、森林、水安全整合为一份企业问卷；2026 年含 13 个模块与 6 类环境议题。
sourceNote: 本页按 CDP 官方文件整理；悬浮「原文」可查看对应官方原文。正式填报请以 CDP 当期问卷与指南为准。

blocks.content_cn: 2024 年起，CDP 将气候、森林、水安全三套问卷整合为一份企业问卷，鼓励更整体的报告。

quote.text: In 2024, the CDP corporate questionnaires on climate change, forests, and water security were integrated into one corporate questionnaire.

blocks.content_cn: 2026 年首次引入海洋（Ocean）议题数据点，自然议题覆盖范围扩大。

quote.text: In 2026, datapoints on ocean disclosure are introduced for the first time.

rows: 覆盖多个环境议题，按议题分别评分
各模块仅对应单一环境议题
金融部门的整合型环境绩效模块

blocks.content_cn: 整合模块的问题会被多个议题评分；环境绩效模块仅由对应议题评分。

quote.text: There are 13 modules in the full corporate questionnaire. Modules 1 to 6, and 13 are integrated, which means that questions in these modules cover more than one environmental issue area.

blocks.title: 六类环境议题的呈现规则

cards.title: 气候变化
cards.content: 所有披露方必答，并完成评分。

cards.title: 森林 / 水安全
cards.content: 仅在被邀请或自选披露时呈现并评分。

cards.title: 生物多样性
cards.content: 所有披露方呈现补充数据点，2026 年不计分。

cards.title: 海洋 / 塑料
cards.content: 仅在自选披露时呈现，2026 年不计分。
气候为必备议题，森林与水安全按邀请或自选呈现，其余为补充或自选。
cards.title: 气候为必备议题…

quote.text: All disclosers will be presented with datapoints on climate change, as well as supplementary datapoints on biodiversity.

sections.title: 完整版 vs 中小企业版

cards.content: 员工超 1000 人或年收入超 2.5 亿美元的企业只能填完整版；其余可填中小企业版。
cards.title: 员工超 1000 人或年收入超 …

quote.text: Organizations with a headcount of more than 1,000 total employees or annual revenue of more than US$250 million can only complete the full corporate questionnaire.

cards.content: 中小企业版问题更少、更简化，低于门槛的企业也可自选完整版。
cards.title: 中小企业版问题更少、更简化…

quote.text: The SME questionnaire is tailored to the needs of SMEs and contains fewer and simplified datapoints.

cards.title: IFRS S2 / ISSB
cards.content: 气候标准作为 CDP 气候披露的基线。

cards.title: TCFD
cards.content: 自 2018 年起与 TCFD 建议保持一致。

cards.title: TNFD
cards.content: 2026 年更新对自然相关财务披露框架的对齐。

cards.title: GRI / ESRS / EMF
cards.content: 与 GRI、ESRS E1、艾伦·麦克阿瑟基金会承诺对齐。
CDP 问卷跟随最新科学，并与高质量披露框架和标准保持一致。
cards.title: CDP 问卷跟随最新科学…

quote.text: The CDP full corporate questionnaire follows the latest science and aligns with new high-quality disclosure frameworks and standards.
